stages.name: a
stages.query: SELECT __path,ast_kind AS kind,ast_name AS name,ast_alias AS alias,ast_module AS module,NULL AS value,NULL AS value_kind,CAST(NULLIF(ast_preorder,'') AS INTEGER) AS id,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS bfs,CAST(NULLIF(ast_parent,'') AS INTEGER) AS parent,ast_field AS field,CAST(NULLIF(ast_index,'') AS INTEGER) AS position,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS last,CAST(NULLIF(ast_function,'') AS INTEGER) AS fn,NULL AS op,CAST(NULLIF(ast_start,'') AS INTEGER) AS __start,CAST(NULLIF(ast_stop,'') AS INTEGER) AS __end,CAST(NULLIF(ast_line,'') AS INTEGER) AS line,NULL AS context,NULL AS name_repr,NULL AS value_repr,ast_annotation AS annotation,NULL AS annotation_repr,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS cls,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS level FROM canonical

stages.name: calls
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.name AS callee,f.id AS callee_id,r.id AS receiver,r.kind AS receiver_kind,r.name AS receiver_name
      FROM a c JOIN a f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.parent=c.id AND f.field='func'
      LEFT JOIN a r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.parent=f.id AND r.field='value'
      WHERE c.kind='Call'

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE kind IN ('FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef')

stages.name: parameters
stages.query: SELECT p.* FROM a p JOIN a arguments ON arguments.__path=p.__path AND arguments.id=p.parent AND arguments.kind='arguments' JOIN functions f ON f.__path=arguments.__path AND f.id=arguments.parent WHERE p.kind='arg'

stages.name: index_aliases
stages.query: SELECT __path,alias name,id FROM a WHERE kind='alias' AND name='Index' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a p WHERE p.__path=a.__path AND p.id=a.parent AND p.kind='ImportFrom' AND p.module='l1000_schema.schema_def') AND alias!=''

stages.name: schema_aliases
stages.query: SELECT __path,CASE WHEN alias='' THEN 'schema_def' ELSE alias END name,id FROM a WHERE kind='alias' AND name='l1000_schema.schema_def' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a p WHERE p.__path=a.__path AND p.id=a.parent AND p.kind='Import')

stages.name: index_calls
stages.query: SELECT n.* FROM calls n WHERE n.callee_kind='Name' AND (n.callee='Index' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM index_aliases s WHERE s.__path=n.__path AND s.name=n.callee AND s.id<n.id)) OR n.callee_kind='Attribute' AND n.callee='Index' AND n.receiver_kind='Name' AND (n.receiver_name='schema_def' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM schema_aliases s WHERE s.__path=n.__path AND s.name=n.receiver_name AND s.id<n.id))

stages.name: source_parameters
stages.query: SELECT p.*,v.annotation AS source_annotation FROM parameters p LEFT JOIN a v ON v.__path=p.__path AND v.parent=p.id AND v.field='annotation' WHERE p.name='source' AND p.field IN ('args','kwonlyargs') AND p.id=(SELECT min(first.id) FROM parameters first WHERE first.__path=p.__path AND first.fn=p.fn AND first.name=p.name AND first.field IN ('args','kwonlyargs'))

relational.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'missing_source' AS issue,'generated indexes must use _generated_index(..., source=IndexSource.*)' AS message,n.id||':missing_source:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM index_calls n LEFT JOIN functions f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.fn WHERE coalesce(f.name,'')!='_generated_index' UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'missing_source' AS issue,'_generated_index must forward source=source into Index(...)' AS message,n.id||':missing_source:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM index_calls n JOIN functions f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.fn WHERE f.name='_generated_index' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a kw JOIN a v ON v.__path=kw.__path AND v.parent=kw.id AND v.field='value' WHERE kw.__path=n.__path AND kw.parent=n.id AND kw.field='keywords' AND kw.name='source' AND kw.position=(SELECT min(first.position) FROM a first WHERE first.__path=kw.__path AND first.parent=kw.parent AND first.field='keywords' AND first.name='source') AND v.kind='Name' AND v.name='source') UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'missing_source' AS issue,'_generated_index must require a source: IndexSource parameter' AS message,n.id||':missing_source:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM functions n WHERE n.kind='FunctionDef' AND n.name='_generated_index' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM source_parameters p WHERE p.__path=n.__path AND p.fn=n.id) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'missing_source' AS issue,'_generated_index source parameter must be annotated as IndexSource' AS message,n.id||':missing_source:'||(n.id+0.001) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id+0.001 AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM functions n JOIN source_parameters p ON p.__path=n.__path AND p.fn=n.id WHERE n.kind='FunctionDef' AND n.name='_generated_index' AND coalesce(p.source_annotation,'')!='IndexSource' UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'missing_source' AS issue,'_generated_index source must not default to MODEL_DECLARED' AS message,n.id||':missing_source:'||(n.id+0.002) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id+0.002 AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM functions n JOIN parameters p ON p.__path=n.__path AND p.fn=n.id JOIN a arglist ON arglist.__path=p.__path AND arglist.id=p.parent JOIN a d ON d.__path=arglist.__path AND d.parent=arglist.id AND d.field='kw_defaults' AND d.position=p.position WHERE n.kind='FunctionDef' AND n.name='_generated_index' AND p.field='kwonlyargs' AND p.name='source' AND p.position=(SELECT max(last.position) FROM parameters last WHERE last.__path=p.__path AND last.fn=p.fn AND last.name=p.name AND last.field='kwonlyargs') AND (d.kind='Name' AND d.name='MODEL_DECLARED' OR d.kind='Attribute' AND d.name='MODEL_DECLARED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a value WHERE value.__path=d.__path AND value.parent=d.id AND value.field='value' AND (value.kind='Name' AND value.name='IndexSource')))
